"Double The Money" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About half of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $100,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

If you play "Double The Money" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2415.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

2416.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "Loaded with $2,000s" have been sold. The game is well into its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Everything here about "Loaded with $2,000s" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 6.

2419.headline: How much has sold

2420.headline: What's actually left to win

2421.body:
A $577,777 top prize on "Gold 7s" was claimed last week. The game started with three top prizes and has one top prize left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Tomorrow's count on "Gold 7s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2421.headline: A player won a top prize

2422.body:
Platinum 7s's prizes make it a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, about two-thirds is in wins under $2,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

Everything above about "Platinum 7s" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

2427.headline: What's actually left to win

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" is new from the Virginia Lottery. It is a $2 game with five top prizes of $25,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Every line of PEPPERMINT PAYOUT's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2428.headline: First day on sale

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" just went on sale in Virginia. The game has eleven full prize levels with four top prizes of $125,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

If you play "MERRY MONEY TREE" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2429.headline: New game, all prizes left

2430.body:
"WRAPPED IN RICHES" just reached Virginia stores with three top prizes of $500,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

If you play "WRAPPED IN RICHES" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
